Name: Configure Machine Speed Multiplayer
Author: tbonehunter
Description:
Allows the player to configure the processing speed of any vanilla (or added using standard machine parameters) machine in SV 1.6.xxx. Configurable via GMCM on a per-machine or global basis, with ability to exclude individual machines from the global setting. Multiplayer mode uses Host settings for all players. Setting of 0% means instantaneous. Solar panels, when set to 0, will produce their batteries the next day. Default config upon installation of mod is 100, meaning all machines will operate at normal game speed until you modify them either in GMCM or in the config file which is created upon game start. 

Version 1.1.0 fixed bug keeping passive machines (lightning rods, tappers, beehives, etc.) from processing other than normal speed. Version 1.1.1 updates cask method to be instantaneous rather than next game tick.

Downloads.Description: Configure processing speed for any machine as a percentage, with per-machine overrides and multiplayer support. Update 1.1.1 makes casks truly instantaneous when speed is set to 0, to match other machines.
